events.title: China LPR decision (August)
events.why_it_matters: China kept 1-yr LPR at 3.00% and 5-yr at 3.50% for the 15th straight month, in line with expectations, signaling Beijing's preference for fiscal over monetary easing amid weak July data.

events.title: Walmart Q2 FY27 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Largest US retailer gives the definitive read on the K-shaped consumer and inflation pressure.
events.what_to_watch: US comp sales, e-commerce growth, and FY guidance.

events.title: FOMC minutes (July 28-29 meeting) released
events.why_it_matters: Minutes revealed a more hawkish undercurrent than expected, with 3 dissents for a hike and broad discussion of a September hike if inflation doesn't cool.
events.what_to_watch: Market pricing of September 16 FOMC hike (~31% probability).

events.title: Eurozone Flash PMI (August)
events.why_it_matters: Early gauge of Eurozone momentum after July's composite hit 52.0; influences ECB policy expectations.
events.what_to_watch: Whether manufacturing holds above 50 and services strength persists.

events.title: US New Home Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing recovery gauge after housing starts plunged 12.4% in July.

events.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (August)
events.why_it_matters: July fell to 90.8; August expected to weaken further on Middle East energy costs.

events.title: US PCE Inflation (July)
events.why_it_matters: Fed's preferred inflation gauge; June core was 3.3% y/y.
events.what_to_watch: Whether core PCE cools toward 3.0% or re-accelerates on energy.

events.title: US Durable Goods Orders (July)
events.why_it_matters: Core capital goods orders gauge business investment amid tariff headwinds.

events.title: US Q2 GDP Second Estimate
events.why_it_matters: Advance estimate was 1.5% annualized, below the 2.1% forecast; revisions shift Fed rate expectations.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the second estimate revises growth up or down.

events.title: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
events.why_it_matters: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech as chair; topic is 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.'
events.what_to_watch: Warsh's signals on September rate hike.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY27 earnings
events.why_it_matters: The most important earnings event of the quarter; revenue guidance ~$91B, AI data-center buildout.
events.what_to_watch: Blackwell/Vera Rubin ramp, guidance, and AI capex commentary.

events.title: Salesforce, Dell, HP, and other tech earnings
events.why_it_matters: Software and hardware bellwethers give read on enterprise IT spending.

events.title: US-Iran ceasefire expired
events.why_it_matters: Two-month MoU expired; Iran says Strait of Hormuz remains closed; US naval blockade continues; Brent above $91.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a new deal emerges or conflict re-escalates.

events.title: Taiwan Legislative Yuan passed 2026 general budget
events.why_it_matters: Ends nearly year-long delay; funds defense and infrastructure.

events.title: CLARITY Act Senate vote
events.why_it_matters: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act would reshape crypto oversight; cloture vote pushed to September.

events.title: Section 232 drone tariffs (up to 100%)
events.why_it_matters: Escalates US-China tech decoupling; tariffs on drones and components.
events.what_to_watch: Legal challenges, allied exemptions (EU 15%, UK 10%, Korea 15%).

events.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets
events.why_it_matters: First formal crypto regulatory framework; creates exemptions and safe harbors.

events.title: Childhood vaccine executive order
events.why_it_matters: EO urging fewer/spaced-out vaccines; CDC guidance unchanged.

events.title: Birth tourism/citizenship EO
events.why_it_matters: Restricts birthright citizenship; legal challenges expected.

events.title: 25 states sue over new tariffs
events.why_it_matters: Legal challenge to tariff round; could enjoin new duties.

events.title: US CPI (July)
events.why_it_matters: Headline +0.1% m/m, 3.4% y/y; core 2.5% y/y. Energy prices elevated from Iran conflict.

events.title: US Retail Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Fell 0.6% m/m, biggest drop in over a year; consumers pulling back.
events.what_to_watch: Whether spending weakness persists into Q3.

events.title: US Housing Starts (July)
events.why_it_matters: Plunged 12.4% to 1.239M annualized, second-lowest post-pandemic.

events.title: US Existing Home Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Fell 1.7% to 4.06M SAAR; median price record $434,100.

events.title: UMich Consumer Sentiment (prelim August)
events.why_it_matters: Fell to 51.0 from 55.2; 1-yr inflation expectations rose to 4.3%.

events.title: US Jobs Report (July)
events.why_it_matters: Lost 23,000 jobs; unemployment 4.2%; labor market cracking.

events.title: US PPI (July)
events.why_it_matters: Producer prices cooling; energy drag.

events.title: China Activity Data (July)
events.why_it_matters: Weak domestic demand; Q2 GDP 4.7% y/y.

events.title: US-Iran war / Strait of Hormuz closure
events.why_it_matters: Naval blockade, Hormuz closed, oil above $91, strategic reserves below 300M barrels.

events.title: 2026 Atlantic hurricane season
events.why_it_matters: Below-normal forecast; Cristobal formed Aug 12; Super El Niño suppresses storms but warm Atlantic waters could fuel late-season systems.

events.title: South Korea semiconductor supercycle
events.why_it_matters: Record exports; Korea Semiconductor Act took effect Aug 11; AI chip demand.

events.title: OPEC+ Monthly Meeting
events.why_it_matters: Group agreed to +188k bpd in September, completing rollback of voluntary cuts; next meeting reviews Q4.
events.what_to_watch: Whether they pause Q4 increases given Middle East supply risks.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (August)
events.why_it_matters: July hit 55.6, highest in 38 months; gauge of tariff-driven manufacturing strength.

events.title: US Employment Situation (August)
events.why_it_matters: July lost 23,000 jobs, first negative print in years; August report will be pivotal for September FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the labor market deterioration continues.

top_risks: US-Iran conflict re-escalation — Ceasefire expired Aug 18; Hormuz closed; oil above $91; naval blockade indefinite. Any new attack could spike oil toward $100+ and trigger broad risk-off.
Fed September rate hike — FOMC minutes show hawkish undercurrent; 3 dissents for hike; markets price ~31% chance. A hike would tighten financial conditions into a weakening labor market.
US labor market deterioration — July lost 23K jobs; retail sales fell 0.6%; consumer sentiment at 51.0. August jobs report (Sept 4) could confirm recession risk.
Section 232 drone tariffs escalation — Effective Sept 3; could trigger retaliation and deepen US-China tech decoupling.
China growth slowdown — Q2 GDP 4.7%, weak July activity data, no major stimulus appetite. Global commodity and EM risk.
top_opportunities: Nvidia earnings (Aug 26) — AI capex supercycle intact; $91B revenue guidance; Blackwell/Vera Rubin ramp. Could drive semiconductor complex higher.
South Korea semiconductor supercycle — Record exports, AI chip demand, Korea Semiconductor Act. Beneficiary of global AI buildout.
OPEC+ supply discipline — Group completing rollback of voluntary cuts but may pause Q4; oil supply tight with Hormuz closed.
US manufacturing strength — ISM at 55.6, highest in 38 months; tariff-driven reshoring.
SEC crypto framework — First formal crypto regulation could unlock institutional participation.
summary: The combination of an expired US-Iran ceasefire with Hormuz closed, a hawkish Fed facing a weakening labor market, and a pivotal Nvidia earnings report creates a high-variance environment where multiple regime-changing events are live simultaneously.
